description: The Clorox Company is a leading multinational manufacturer and marketer of consumer and professional products, with fiscal year 2026 net sales of $6.7 billion and about 9,200 employees worldwide as of June 30, 2026, operations in approximately 25 countries or territories and sales in approximately 95 markets primarily through mass retailers, grocery outlets, warehouse clubs, dollar stores, home hardware centers, drug, pet and military stores, third-party and owned e-commerce channels and distributors. It markets some of the most trusted and recognized consumer brand names, including Clorox cleaning and disinfecting products, Pine-Sol cleaner, Liquid-Plumr clog removers, Poett home care products, Glad bags and wraps, Fresh Step cat litter, Kingsford grilling products, Hidden Valley dressings, dips, seasonings and sauces, Brita water-filtration products and Burt's Bees natural personal care products, and it also markets industry-leading products and technologies for professional customers.
